sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1 which must be performed 
every 10 years bases as indicated by Y10 in the title block.

The technical specifications of the circuit breaker : Rated current = 
2000A and short circuit 40kA/3 second, pneumatic mechanism.

The first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
eng. Soleiman Abd Elfattah Soleiman 
on Feb 2002,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required
Wear safety helmet, shoes, safety glasses ...
Switch off CB.
Switch off the DC & AC supply. (CB is electrically dead)
Switch off the disconnectors on C.B sides and grounded the C.B sides
The CB in not under pressure (all compressed air is released)

sections.text: Steps of Dismantling and Maintenance

Dismantle the terminals 
from the both sides of CB
Dismantle the twin head, dismantle the capacitors and transport the twin head to work shop

Measure the capacitance of 
the capacitors

Measure the (closing & 
opening) strokes and record it

Dismantle the parallel (preinsertion) 
resistors from twin head end measure the resistance

Check and maintenance the 
mechanism and moving contacts of resistors

Check the presence of 
overheat and flashover on breaking units components

Check the presence of 
surface defects or cracks on breaking units components

Dismantle the (moving 
stationary) contacts of interrupters, clean and lubricate the (puffer cy1., 
arcing pins, crown)

Inspect the external 
insulator of breaking units

Replace the old O - rings 
by new O - rings before mounting the all parts of twin head and parallel 
resistors
Steps before Mounting the 
twin head on Circuit Breaker

Measure the (closing, 
opening) strokes and compare it with the reading of step 4 in the previous steps

Measure the resistance of 
parallel resistors and compare it by the previous reading

Dismantle and maintenance 
(drive group, closing value, opening value, main piston) of pneumatic mechanism 
(lubricate all parts and new - o - ring)

Change the gas. SF6 
isolating flange by new one

Transport twin head from 
workshop to site of CB and mantle it

Mantle all parts of 
pneumatic mechanism of step (14)

Check and inspect the 
insulation of support column and its tightening
Repeat all steps (1 to18) every twin head and pneumatic mechanism of all C.B phases respectively
